paper.title: PerfCodeBench: Benchmarking LLMs for System-Level High-Performance Code Optimization
evidence: Paper describes 1,854 executable tasks across C, C++, Go, Java, Python, and CUDA.
Each task includes metadata, benchmark harness, baseline implementation, reference implementation, and writable candidate slot.
Correctness is checked by deterministic task-specific oracles.
Performance is measured through repeated runs and median latency.
Direct README path https://anonymous.4open.science/r/perfcodebench-7CDE/README.md returned Markdown documentation.

Direct paths for configs.json, scripts/run_openai_codegen_eval.py, scripts/run_model_suite.py, executable_tasks/fast_float_parse/instance.json, baseline/solution.cpp, and harness/benchmark_main.cpp returned expected files.
git ls-remote https://anonymous.4open.science/r/perfcodebench-7CDE.git returned repository not found.
curl -L -I https://anonymous.4open.science/r/perfcodebench-7CDE redirected to /api/repo/perfcodebench-7CDE/file/ and returned HTTP 401.

contract.artifactSource: paper verified; direct file paths available; clone/archive/listing not verified

sampleInstance.title: Optimize decimal parsing throughput
sampleInstance.goal: Parse a large newline-delimited decimal buffer and return the sum of all values.
sampleInstance.metric: median elapsed_ns over repeated runs; lower is better
sampleInstance.correctness_rule: Returned sum must be within relative tolerance 1e-12 of the expected sum.

scoreSemantics.correctness: candidate must compile, run, and pass the task-specific oracle before receiving performance credit
metrics: FBR: faster-than-baseline rate for correct candidates
RBR: reference-or-better rate for correct candidates
CGRE_ge_0.8: share of comparable tasks closing at least 80 percent of the baseline-to-reference gap
scoreSemantics.blockedReason: score smoke still requires a complete runnable checkout, task dependencies, and accepted worker profile

paperEnvironment.cpu: two Intel Xeon Platinum 8480C CPUs, 224 logical CPU cores
paperEnvironment.gpu: three NVIDIA H800 GPUs, 80 GiB each

workerProfile.localAcceptance: not decided; score smoke must record CPU/GPU pool, repetitions, warmups, timeout policy, and noise threshold before claiming benchmark evidence

decision.reason: Direct file access verifies README, scripts, and one sample task, but no clone/archive/listing has been verified and no complete runnable checkout or deterministic worker profile exists.
unblockActions: Materialize a complete runnable checkout from clone, archive, or scripted direct-file fetch.
Record complete repository layout and license/access terms.
Verify selected task dependencies, especially external/ dependencies required by instance.json.
Run a dry or reuse-candidate single-task command locally and capture raw result JSON.
Choose a deterministic local worker profile or provision hardware that satisfies the benchmark's CPU/GPU requirements.
